content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_riscv-dbg_pr56, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# loop bounds incorrect in dm_csrc.sv (line 126)
Hi guys,
there seems to be a bug in dm_csrs.sv (master branch, https://github.com/pulp-platform/riscv-dbg/blob/master/src/dm_csrs.sv) line 126:
```
for (int unsigned k = 0; k < NrHarts/2**5+1; k++) begin
halted_flat1[k] = |halted_reshaped0[k];
end
```
The array halted_reshaped0 is defined as:
```
logic [(NrHarts-1)/2**5:0][31:0] halted_reshaped0;
```
Therefore, the loop above will access elements which are non-existing because the loop accesses elements above (NrHarts-1)/2**5+1.
The code should look imho as follows:
```
for (int unsigned k = 0; k < (NrHarts-1)/2**5+1; k++) begin
halted_flat1[k] = |halted_reshaped0[k];
end
```
BR, Dustin
